entities.name: William Williamson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Williamson was an American teacher, lawyer, and judge who served as a U.S. representative from South Dakota's 3rd congressional district from 1921 to 1933, as a member of the Republican Party. He was the final representative of the 3rd district before its dissolution.
